description: This file defines a React component for a Next.js frontend application. It manages the UI for uploading documents, generating, viewing, and editing a persona profile through various states, including handling file uploads, backend API interactions, orchestration status polling, and persona data display and editing. The component utilizes hooks for state management and effects for data fetching and polling, along with Tailwind CSS for styling and Framer Motion for animations.
